mapper.update: UPDATE post_like SET status = 0, deleted_id = id WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_id = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT l.user_id AS user_id, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, COALESCE(u.avatar_url, '') AS avatar_url, l.create_time AS liked_at FROM post_like l INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = l.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
l.post_id = #{postId} AND l.status = 1 AND l.deleted_id = 0
AND ( l.create_time < #{cursorCreateTime} OR (l.create_time = #{cursorCreateTime} AND l.user_id < #{cursorUserId}) )
ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
